arithmetic: Each exec attempt is bounded to at most 30 seconds.
An idle helper receives min(150-second helper ceiling, 30-second caller allowance, remaining operation/session/priced time), hence at most 30 seconds.
At most three helper attempts share that single deadline. A first attempt consuming 30 seconds leaves 30 - 30 = 0 seconds for another attempt.
Telemetry recovery is bounded by 300 seconds and the earlier session/priced cap.
L4 manifest wall cap is 30 * 60 = 1800 seconds; operational wall deadline reserves 45 seconds, yielding 1755 seconds.
Recorded total elapsed 520.6077877499629 seconds is below both limits.
The later profile manifest wall cap is 160 * 60 = 9600 seconds; operational wall deadline is 9600 - 45 = 9555 seconds.
